verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm ChatGPT accepts photo/screenshot uploads and interprets their content (e.g., transcribing a handwritten recipe or identifying a landmark from a photo), which directly matches the knowledge-worker use case of sharing images for analysis. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence corroborating accuracy of image interpretation, and explicit documentation of screenshot-specific analysis (e.g., UI screenshots) rather than just general photo uploads.
